title: Posco hosts 2026 forum to map AX-GX strategies, signs 26 partnership deals
dek: POSCO hosted a 2026 forum to map its AX-GX strategies and signed 26 partnership deals, according to Chosunbiz.
summary: According to Chosunbiz, POSCO hosted a 2026 forum to map out its AX-GX strategies and signed 26 partnership deals. No excerpt was provided, so the partners and the content of the agreements are not available.
keyFacts: POSCO signed 26 partnership deals at the forum
whyItMatters: The forum suggests POSCO is pursuing its transformation strategy through a broad set of partnerships, though the material does not specify their substance.
implications: Suppliers and technology partners may find opportunities as POSCO formalises its strategy; details will need to be watched for.
